description: Renovate is the only updater here, and platformAutomerge is the only merge mechanism.
The previous setup could not merge anything: the Renovate onboarding PR was closed without
a config, leaving Renovate inert, while a dependabot-automerge workflow armed
`gh pr merge --auto --squash` — a strategy this repo disallows, so every arming attempt
failed. That workflow is gone; this file is self-contained.
The repo allows merge commits only, so automergeStrategy is `merge`.

packageRules.description: The packageManager pin is toolchain, so non-major updates merge themselves.
The toolchain pins (mise, nvm) move with packageManager, so they merge themselves too.
devDependencies and GitHub Actions carry no published surface, so a green `code / all-checks` is the whole review. Majors stay manual either way.

Runtime `dependencies` reach consumers, so they need a changeset. Changesets decides the release from the changeset FILE, not the commit message — an automerged runtime bump with no changeset publishes nothing and the registry version never moves. Kept manual so a human adds one.
Majors break builds in ways CI catches but a human should choose to absorb.
